title: Embodied fly, stage 1e: the FlyWire brain drives the male nerve cord through matched descending neurons (SIMULATED, open loop)
roadmap: report/ROADMAP_EMBODIED_FLY.md §7 (revised plan: each connectome where its model is validated)
seen_before_registration: every result of stages 1-1d; stage 1d: in the male nerve cord, driving aDN1 + aDN2 holds the claw near the head for 0.9665 of the second

data only: 1,267 of 1,303 FlyWire descending neurons match a male-CNS descending neuron by cell type and side; 1,289 of 1,314 male-CNS descending neurons have a FlyWire counterpart; DNg62 (aDN1) and DNge078 (aDN2) exist on both sides in both connectomes
parent sweep, vehicle: under JO-CE drive the FlyWire model's aDN1 (DNg62, one neuron) fires; under sugar drive about 42 descending neurons reach 10 Hz

design.brain: the published model on FlyWire 783 (w_syn 0.275 mV, Shiu constants), drives at 150 Hz: JO-CE (the published set), sugar (the published right-side sugar set), or none; 1 s; spikes of every descending neuron recorded
design.matching: a FlyWire descending neuron and a male-CNS descending neuron match when the male-CNS type or flywireType equals the FlyWire cell_type and the sides agree (left -> L, right -> R); within a (type, side), neurons are paired in order of their IDs, and if the male CNS has more, they receive the FlyWire trains in turn
design.nerve_cord: the stage-1c network (male CNS, nerve cord with descending and ascending neurons, brain removed, w_syn 0.275 mV); each matched male-CNS descending neuron receives its FlyWire partner's spike train, each spike a suprathreshold input (w_syn x 250, as the published stimulus)
design.leg_and_readouts: exactly stage 1d: motor-neuron map, rate filter, activation (r_full 20 Hz primary; 10, 40 Hz), FlyMimic leg, time near the head (claw < 1.328 mm), rhythmicity; left-leg motor pools
design.lesion: the JO-CE trials replayed with the spikes of every DNg62 and DNge078 (aDN1, aDN2) removed
design.seeds: 750-757, the same seed for the brain and the nerve cord of a trial

E0_the_grooming_neurons_are_reached.statement: Antennal drive in the FlyWire brain makes the grooming descending neurons fire
E0_the_grooming_neurons_are_reached.test: mean rate of the FlyWire DNg62 and DNge078 neurons under JO-CE >= 10 Hz; if not, E1-E4 are uninterpretable

E1_antennal_input_holds_the_leg_at_the_h.statement: Antennal input to the brain, relayed through the nerve cord, holds the claw near the head, far longer than sugar input or none
E1_antennal_input_holds_the_leg_at_the_h.test: median time near head under JO-CE >= 0.5 and at least 0.25 above the sugar and no-drive medians (r_full 20 Hz)

E2_the_front_leg_is_the_one_that_moves.statement: Under antennal input the left front-leg motor pool fires more than the middle and hind pools, and more than under sugar input
E2_the_front_leg_is_the_one_that_moves.test: front > middle, front > hind, front(JO-CE) > front(sugar)

E3_the_activation_scale_does_not_decide_.statement: E1 holds at the other activation scales
E3_the_activation_scale_does_not_decide_.test: E1's test holds at r_full 10 Hz and 40 Hz

E4_the_reach_runs_through_the_grooming_n.statement: Removing the grooming descending neurons' spikes abolishes most of the reach
E4_the_reach_runs_through_the_grooming_n.test: median time near head under JO-CE with aDN1 and aDN2 removed at least 0.25 below the intact JO-CE median

not_claimed_even_if_all_pass: that a fly's brain and nerve cord work this way: two connectomes of different flies and sexes are joined by cell type, the loop is open, the leg is one muscle-driven leg; a pass means the validated brain model and the male nerve cord, joined by the published cell types, turn antennal input into a held reach and sugar input not
reporting: Every prediction with its value and pass/fail, whichever way it falls; matching coverage reported.
